about_the_game:
Car Dealer Simulator is about to reach a whole new level with the Up 2 You DLC - and it’s all on your terms.

The Up 2 You DLC lets you customize literally everything, with a special focus on tuning and personalizing cars!

With new tools, you’ll be able to design your own logo and use it to give a unique style to your dealership and vehicles. Change wall and roof materials, repaint inside and out, decorate with posters, and swap out furniture. Add both interior and exterior decorations to truly make the place your own.

The wide range of options in this DLC ensures that your dealership, workshop, parking lot, and even your employees will reflect your personal vision.

Up 2 You also brings full car tuning and customization - not only for your own rides but also for the ones you sell. You’ll have access to a complete palette of colors, paint types, patterns, and decals to make cars stand out. Swap wheels, rims, and windows, and add tuning elements like spoilers, stronger engines, or extra exhausts. All for your customers!

To attract more buyers, you’ll also gain new features in Photo Mode - choose custom backdrops, apply effects, add graphics, and place your logo to make your listings even more appealing.

Meanwhile, a mysterious group of car enthusiasts will appear in Wingston Springs, gathering from time to time outside the city...

... which leads to the biggest surprise: not every car has to be for sale. Get your ultimate ride ready and join illegal street races - where the stakes are nothing less than the cars of other participants.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0 GHz or Ryzen 5 3000
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 / Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 3.5 Ghz or Ryzen 7 5000 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3070 / Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
